doc.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015

title: The Rossano Sportiello Trio and the Arbors record Bridging the Gap
summary: How the trio with Nicki Parrott and Rossano Sportiello started as his idea for Arbors and produced Bridging the Gap.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: It makes people listen. And sometimes we’ll start a concert with Rossano. This trio has kind of evolved into the Rossano Sportiello Trio. You know Nicki will front it, or sometimes I will front it, it’s kind of Rossano’s band. It started as my idea, presenting it to Arbors — oh I’d love to record with Nicki and Rossano. And Mat Domber went, “okay, when?” And, “it’s your record.” And that was okay. So I did that “Bridging the Gap” record.
I have it here. And I thought it was so cool like you’ve got a Steely Dan song on there.
